data.heading: ItineraryByWaypoints
data.text: An itinerary geometry encoded as an ordered sequence of features (waypoints).

data.heading: PointGeometryList
data.text: An ordered list of member point geometries.

data.heading: PositionConfidenceEllipse
data.text: A confidence ellipse describing uncertainty of a point position in a horizontal plane.

data.heading: PointByProjectedCoordinates
data.text: A point location geometry encoded as projected coordinates and optional elements, such as elevation and metadata.

data.heading: AreaByMultiPolygon
data.text: An area geometry encoded as a MultiPolygon geometry.

data.heading: PointFeature
data.text: A spatial feature with no length in any of the spatial dimensions (a point phenomenon in space).

data.heading: LinearGeometry
data.text: A geometry that encodes a linear location using a specific method.

data.heading: PointByCoordinates
data.text: A coordinate tuple defining the geodetic position of a single point location using a known geodetic reference system

data.heading: Elevation
data.text: An elevation for a point location along with metadata.

data.heading: FeatureList
data.text: An ordered list of member features (e.g., itinerary waypoints).

data.heading: AreaByRectangle
data.text: An area geometry encoded as a rectangle, defined by a lower-left corner and an upper-right corner.

data.heading: LinearByPointGeometries
data.text: A linear geometry encoded as an ordered sequence of point geometries.

data.heading: AreaFeature
data.text: A spatial feature enclosed within a two-dimensional boundary or boundaries across a defined surface.

data.heading: LocationGroup
data.text: An unordered set of multiple physically separate features (each typically a singular feature with its own geometry).

data.heading: ItineraryGeometry
data.text: A geometry that encodes an itinerary using a specific method.

data.heading: FacilityCategoryCode
data.text: A code that identifies a category of facility.

attributesChanged.heading: FacilityCode
attributesChanged.text: A code that identifies a type of facility.

data.heading: Itinerary
data.text: An ordered set of multiple physically separate features forming a route or itinerary.

data.heading: PointByCode
data.text: A point geometry whose coordinates are not modelled here but can be resolved using :hasLookupCode and an external location referencing system.

data.heading: MeasurementErrorCode
data.text: A code identifying an error condition or qualification for a measurement value.

data.heading: LinearByCode
data.text: A linear geometry whose extent is not modelled here but can be resolved using :hasLookupCode and an external location referencing system.

data.heading: LocationCode
data.text: A code that identifies (or can be used to look up) a location in some external referencing system.

data.heading: LocationThing
data.text: Parent class for location domain concepts.

data.heading: AreaByLinearBoundaries
data.text: An area geometry encoded as a set of linear boundary geometries.

data.heading: PointByGeoCoordinates
data.text: A point location geometry encoded as latitude/longitude and optional elements, such as elevation and metadata.

data.heading: AreaByGrid
data.text: An area geometry encoded as a grid. The rectangle defined by lower-left and upper-right is the base cell, which is replicated eastward (columns) and northward (rows).

data.heading: CodedGeometry
data.text: A geometry whose extent is resolved via an external code, registry, or service (a pointer to a geometry held elsewhere).

data.heading: AreaGeometry
data.text: A geometry that encodes an area location using a specific method.

data.heading: ItineraryCode
data.text: An itinerary geometry whose route geometry is not modelled here but can be resolved using :hasLookupCode and an external itinerary/route referencing system.

data.heading: PositionAccuracy
data.text: A statement of positional accuracy for a point geometry.

data.heading: AreaByPolygon
data.text: An area geometry encoded as a Polygon geometry.

data.heading: LinearByLinearRing
data.text: A linear geometry encoded as a LinearRing geometry.

data.heading: LinearByPointFeatures
data.text: A linear geometry encoded as an ordered sequence of points.

data.heading: PointGeometry
data.text: A geometry for a point location using a specific method (e.g., coordinates or an external code).

data.heading: Geometry
data.text: A description of a spatial location in the real world according to a defined reference system.

data.heading: LinearByMultiLineString
data.text: A linear geometry encoded as a MultiLineString geometry.

data.heading: Feature
data.text: An abstraction of real-world phenomena. An ITS-domain feature (subclass of geo:Feature) used to model real-world things that have a spatial location.

data.heading: LinearByLineString
data.text: A linear geometry encoded as a LineString geometry.

data.heading: AreaByCircle
data.text: An area geometry encoded as a circle.

data.heading: CoordinateGeometry
data.text: A geometry that is represented by a coordinate system (i.e., directly encodes coordinate tuples).

data.heading: AreaByCode
data.text: An area geometry whose extent is not modelled here but can be resolved using :hasLookupCode and an external location referencing system.

data.heading: PointFeatureList
data.text: An ordered list of member point features.

data.heading: OffsetDistance
data.text: An offset distance expressed either as a length or as a percentage.

data.heading: CoordinateReferenceSystem
data.text: A coordinate reference system (CRS) used to interpret coordinate tuples in a CoordinateGeometry. Typically identified using an OGC CRS IRI such as http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/EPSG/0/4326.

data.heading: ElevationAccuracy
data.text: A statement of elevation accuracy for a point geometry.

data.heading: DistanceAccuracy
data.text: A statement of distance accuracy for a point geometry.

data.heading: LinearFeature
data.text: A spatial feature that extends along a defined path (typically between two point features or along a network element).

data.heading: PointByLinearPosition
data.text: A point geometry defined by an offset along a linear geometry.

data.heading: ElevationHeightCode
data.text: A code that identifies the height value for an elevation value  (e.g., 'ground layer 1', 'elevated layer 1', 'elevated layer 2', 'tunnel layer 1').

attributesChanged.text: A code that identifies the height value for an elevation value  (e.g., 'ground layer 1', 'elevated layer 1', 'elevated layer 2', 'tunnel layer 1').

data.heading: SpatialObject
data.text: A spatial object within the ITS domain (subclass of geo:SpatialObject).

data.heading: ElevationReferenceCode
data.text: A code that identifies the reference system for an elevation value  (e.g., 'ellipsoidal', 'gravityRelated', 'ground level', 'EPSG:5701', 'coded height').

attributesChanged.text: A code that identifies the reference system for an elevation value  (e.g., 'ellipsoidal', 'gravityRelated', 'ground level', 'EPSG:5701', 'coded height').

data.heading: hasElevation
data.text: Associates a point geometry with an elevation value.

data.heading: hasElevationDistance
data.text: Elevation distance of a point location, as measured from the elevation reference system.

data.heading: hasElevationHeightCode
data.text: Coded elevation height value of a point location.

data.heading: hasElevationReference
data.text: Reference system for the elevation value.

data.heading: hasElevationAccuracy
data.text: Associates a point geometry with an elevation accuracy statement.

data.heading: hasPositionAccuracy
data.text: Associates a point geometry with a statement of positional accuracy.

data.heading: hasPositionConfidenceEllipse
data.text: Associates a point geometry with a confidence ellipse statement.

data.heading: hasDistanceAccuracy
data.text: The upper limit of the accuracy, expressed as a simple length value (e.g., within 10 meters).

data.heading: confidencePercentage
data.text: Percent confidence in a reported value as defined by the percentile of the cumulative distribution of position errors (e.g., 95% confidence).

data.heading: distanceAccuracyErrorCode
data.text: A code that identifies the error code for a distance accuracy value.

data.heading: semiMajorAxisLength
data.text: Semi-major axis length of the confidence ellipse.

data.heading: semiMinorAxisLength
data.text: Semi-minor axis length of the confidence ellipse.

data.heading: semiMajorAxisOrientation
data.text: Orientation of the semi-major axis of the confidence ellipse.

data.heading: semiMajorAxisLengthErrorCode
data.text: A code qualifying the semi-major axis length measurement.

data.heading: semiMinorAxisLengthErrorCode
data.text: A code qualifying the semi-minor axis length measurement.

data.heading: semiMajorAxisOrientationErrorCode
data.text: A code qualifying the semi-major axis orientation measurement.

data.heading: bearing
data.text: Bearing of a point location.

data.heading: hasLinearBoundary
data.text: Associates an area geometry with linear features that define its boundary.

data.heading: hasCenter
data.text: Center point of a circle area geometry.

data.heading: radius
data.text: Radius of a circle area geometry.

data.heading: hasLowerLeft
data.text: Lower-left (southwestern) point of a rectangle area geometry.

data.heading: hasUpperRight
data.text: Upper-right (northeastern) point of a rectangle area geometry.

data.heading: hasPointList
data.text: Associates LinearByPointFeatures with its ordered list of member points.

data.heading: hasPointGeometryList
data.text: Associates LinearByPointGeometries with its ordered list of member point geometries.

data.heading: hasOffsetDistance
data.text: Associates a PointByLinearPosition with its offset distance value.

data.heading: offsetLength
data.text: Length form of an offset distance.

data.heading: offsetPercentage
data.text: Percentage form of an offset distance.

data.heading: alongLinearGeometry
data.text: Associates a PointByLinearPosition with the linear geometry along which it is located.

data.heading: basePoint
data.text: The base/reference point from which the offset is measured.

data.heading: directionPoint
data.text: A second point used to establish the direction of offset relative to the basePoint.

data.heading: locationContainedInItinerary
data.text: DATEX-aligned property name for associating an itinerary by waypoints with its ordered list of member features.

data.heading: hasWaypointList
data.text: Associates an itinerary by waypoints with its ordered list of member features (waypoints).

data.heading: LocationObjectProperty
data.text: Organizational super-property for location core object properties.

data.heading: hasMember
data.text: Relates a location group to a member feature.

data.heading: hasLookupCode
data.text: Associates a coded geometry with the location code used to retrieve or resolve its geometric extent in an external system.

data.heading: geometryOf
data.text: Inverse of geo:hasGeometry: relates a geometry to the feature it represents.

data.heading: hasCRS
data.text: Associates a CoordinateGeometry with the coordinate reference system used to interpret its coordinate tuples.

data.heading: latitude
data.text: Latitude of a point coordinate (decimal degrees; CRS implied or supplied by the geometry context).

data.heading: longitude
data.text: Longitude of a point coordinate (decimal degrees; CRS implied or supplied by the geometry context).

data.heading: northing
data.text: The northerly (y) dimension of a point coordinate expressed in some linear unit.

data.heading: easting
data.text: The easterly (x) dimension of a point coordinate expressed in some linear unit.

data.heading: numColumns
data.text: Number of times the base rectangle cell is replicated eastward in a grid area geometry. The width of the area is the width of the base cell multiplied by the number of columns.

data.heading: numRows
data.text: Number of times the base rectangle cell is replicated northward in a grid area geometry. The height of the area is the height of the base cell multiplied by the number of rows.

data.heading: LocationDataProperty
data.text: Organizational super-property for location core data properties.

data.heading: coordinateEpoch
data.text: The epoch (observation/realization time) at which the coordinate tuples of a CoordinateGeometry are valid in its CRS. Needed for dynamic reference frames.

data.heading: hasNominalDirection
data.text: Associates a feature with its nominal direction.
